name: Line and Paragraph Spacing
what_it_does: Sets the spacing between lines and before/after paragraphs.
behavior: Opens Line and Paragraph Spacing (menu). Contents (9 controls): 1.0, 1.15, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, Add Space Before Paragraph, Remove Space After Paragraph, Line Spacing Options…. Sub-surfaces: ui:paragraph-dialog. [flyout of subfeature:line-spacing — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule] Appears as stacked lines with up/down arrows and a chevron.
